stopping_conditions: A configured time, compute, or iteration budget is reached.
The data fingerprint, feature availability, or cutoff cannot be verified.
A leakage, duplicate-information, or baseline-parity check fails.
The preregistered sample requirement or holdout is not available.
Independent validation rejects the candidate or reports inconclusive evidence.
acceptance_criteria_source: The experiment's preregistered criteria and the existing repository validation protocol; never invent thresholds after observing results.
